chosen.note: Batch 32 reserved 6,348 MiB, past the card's 6,144 MiB (a GTX 1660 Ti; under WSL2 the allocation spills into shared system memory instead of failing), so batch 16 is the fastest setting that fits in 6 GB. The kv cache, which the checkpoint's generation config turns off so that every one of up to 160 steps re-encodes the whole prefix, leaves the Dresden readings identical to the checkpoint's defaults and changes 1 sweep reading in 2,000, as a change of batch size does without it; half precision is slower on this card, which has no tensor cores, and changes 2 % of the readings, so it is not taken.
